'''Dao Jodh''' was a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] monk who traveled to [[Spintir/Legends|Spintir]] to hone his [[Force power/Legends|Force abilities]].

==Biography==
Dao Jodh acted as a monk in a monastery on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Jiran VII]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] regions; his elders told him he had a special destiny. Jodh later encountered [[Kaveri Ra]] and [[Hethan Romund]] when they traveled to his monastery, to which he and Ra discovered each other's [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitivity]]. He eventually stowed away on their vessel and accompanied them in their journey to [[Spintir/Legends|Spintir]].

After Romund was captured by the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark sider]] [[Malefax]] in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], Jodh joined with other individuals to rescue her.
